description: This file is a shell script used for testing the functionality of the perf-lib library. It defines multiple test cases that verify various features such as repository state, variable exports, environment variables, and function availability.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Runs tests related to the default repository in the perf-lib testing suite.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Executes a performance test with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_export
methods.description: Exports a variable in the test environment.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success with a description.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that the specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or variables.
